note: Runtime-loaded HTML price extraction patterns. Each pattern is a regex that captures a price from HTML source. The first capture group must be the numeric price value. Patterns are tried in order; the first match wins. All patterns must include a currency symbol or code near the price to avoid matching bare numbers. Adding a new pattern requires ONLY editing this file — no recompile.

patterns.name: known_price_container
patterns.description: Amazon-style a-price spans, data-price attributes, generic price classes

patterns.name: meta_tag_price
patterns.description: Meta tag with itemprop=price or product:price:amount

patterns.name: price_text_content
patterns.description: Price as direct text content of a price-related element (requires currency symbol)
